buys: Contracts with preschool sites. FY2027 rates: $18,228 per school-year seat and $26,004 per full-year seat, plus start-up, transportation and inclusion funds. Includes the 24 county staff who manage the contracts.
Extra payments to contracted sites to raise wages and benefits for infant and toddler teachers, sized by each site's infant and toddler seats.
Grants and loans to renovate, expand or build preschool space, with technical assistance. Administered by BuildUp Oregon, a collaboration of four community development lenders.
One dedicated staff person at Portland Permitting & Development to move preschool facility permits through review.
Coaching contracts for preschool teachers, curriculum support, quality assessments, the Pathways Program for providers preparing to join, and capacity grants to school districts and Head Start.
Recruitment, paid internships, community college navigators, scholarships and training for new and current preschool teachers.
Community organizations that help families apply (Family Connectors) and that hold contracts and run payments for home-based and small providers (Intermediaries).
Division leadership, policy, communications, data and operations staff (34 positions in FY2027).
Human Services business and HR staff who execute contracts and pay providers, plus the application and enrollment software.
Preschool for All fund share of the Chair's Office budget.
Preschool for All fund share of a non-departmental communications offer.
Health Department consultants who work with preschools on children's mental health (10.7 positions in FY2026).
Clinical supervision for mental health supports at preschool sites.
